title: Arrangements, Sidney as a boss, and the riverboat
summary: The band used stocks and Joe Phillips arrangements; Sidney was a fine boss; Jackson joined after the band left the boat.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Did he use mostly arrangements? Stock arrangements or special arrangements? What kind of music did you... They used...

They had a few stocks. Then they had Joe Phillip and Alvin Alcorn writing. Joe Phillip used to write for the band. And they used a lot of arrangement that Joe Phillip written for the band. We played those. Then we used a lot of stock. A lot of numbers like Anvil Coores and all. Yeah. The old number. And the band, they really had a wonderful band. I enjoyed the time I played in it. I enjoyed the stay I was in it. And Sidney, he's a wonderful guy to work for. A wonderful guy to play for.
He died about a year ago. In California. In California. Yeah.
I met him there two years ago. Did you ever play on the boat with him? I remember he told us he used to work on the boat. I never did. I never did work the boat.

When I joined the band, it was after they left the boat. Yeah. But I remember Pete Marville and P. Ron, they was on the boat. Yeah. They were wonderful musicians too. Yeah. But Sidney, when I joined Sidney's outfit, they had left the boat. I enjoyed it.
